finding.claim: Hidden folders are handled two ways. check_okf skips dot-folders as sections, but docs/ rglob and _section_concepts rglob still pick up .md files under dot-folders (docs/.hidden/x.md is reported as unlisted, so a docs/.vitepress/ tree would fail). Pick one rule and apply it everywhere. Non-blocking because the fix is a filter plus a test.

fixes.change: Entries inside code fences and links that leave the index's folder are ignored, hidden files are not pages, a non-UTF-8 index is a finding instead of a crash, and helpers and Finding have docstrings and a Literal level.
Tests for fenced example entries, links leaving the folder, hidden pages and a non-UTF-8 index; test helpers get docstrings and a return type.
